The '''Alzarian monarchy''' ruled over the planet of [[Alzar]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the [[King/Legends|King]] was [[Gokus]], with [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Plooz]] being next in line. The monarchy faced the threat of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Sludd]]'s attempted ''coup'' at some stage in the Imperial era, but was saved thanks to the efforts of Plooz and the diplomats [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].
